mintAuthority.summary: apyUSD is an ERC-4626-style strategy wrapper over apxUSD. The canonical Ethereum wrapper mints shares only through deposit/mint flows against apxUSD, while its UUPS mint-logic path is controlled by the Apyx AccessManager and 4/7 Safe. Durable apxUSD issuance is inherited from the reviewed apxUSD issuer authority; recurring TID monitoring reconciles the Ethereum wrapper and inherited backing path.

controls.label: apyUSD ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.capDescription: The wrapper mints apyUSD shares through deposit/mint flows against apxUSD; it does not mint base apxUSD.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770413, asset() returned apxUSD address 0x98A878b1Cd98131B271883B390f68D2c90674665; totalAssets() was nonzero and paused() returned false. The wrapper's share issuance remains deposit-bound and does not mint base apxUSD.

controls.label: Inherited apxUSD signed-order mint authority
controls.evidence: apyUSD inherits the reviewed apxUSD mint-authority profile; Apyx contract documentation describes apxUSD minting through MinterV0 EIP-712 signed orders and AccessManager permissions. The inherited MinterV0 path cannot raise the apxUSD supply cap.

controls.label: Apyx apyUSD UUPS upgrade authority - 4/7 Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25905191, the apyUSD proxy implementation slot held 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112 and authority() returned 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824. The Ethereum AccessManager maps upgradeToAndCall to role 24, and the 4/7 Safe holds that role with a 259200-second delay. The Safe added owner 0x6c927e5B7B895E7f41fBE8B35328Ad2d5E324e79 and raised its threshold from 3 to 4 in transaction 0xd7692f068fd795bae4418b828087e0e86c3cc85ad102af25a2717176f87f5aae at block 25877561. The Apyx ApyUSD source gates _authorizeUpgrade() through AccessManager's restricted modifier; Base's separate CCIP representation and AccessManager are recorded under Bridge Risk.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25905191, apyUSD is a UUPS proxy with implementation 0xfd616567ecc1607f61073951a1e822f7315bb112 and AccessManager authority 0xe167330e2eac88666de253e9607c6d9ae0ca2824. The Apyx source defines apyUSD as an ERC-4626 wrapper over apxUSD: local shares mint against deposited apxUSD, while durable apxUSD issuance remains inherited from the reviewed parent profile. The Ethereum AccessManager role 24 controls upgradeToAndCall and resolves to the same 4/7 Safe with a 259200-second delay; the Safe added owner 0x6c927e5B7B895E7f41fBE8B35328Ad2d5E324e79 and raised its threshold from 3 to 4 in transaction 0xd7692f068fd795bae4418b828087e0e86c3cc85ad102af25a2717176f87f5aae at block 25877561. TID Research's apyUSD dashboard monitors Ethereum backing and reconciliation hourly, and Wolf & Company's recurring examinations establish attestation-only supervision. Base, BNB, and Solana bridge representations and their unresolved administrative surfaces are retained under Bridge Risk rather than Mint Authority.
